Israel said the strike targeted two Hamas engineers involved in weapons production. … More Images from the scene showed the vehicle engulfed in flames as people nearby tried to put out the fire. Civil defence teams later inspected the burned-out wreckage, while ambulances took the casualties to Al-Shifa Hospital. Medical staff received the dead and wounded at the hospital. ADVERTISEMENT ADVERTISEMENT At Al-Shifa, Palestinians later gathered to perform funeral prayers before carrying the bodies away for burial. Palestinian health officials said the explosion had dismembered the victims' bodies and appealed to the public for help identifying the two people killed. The Israel Defense Forces said the strike targeted two Hamas engineers, Hassan Ali Abu Nada and Abd al-Rahim Ahmad Khalil Khawa, whom it accused of being involved in weapons production. The strike came as fighting continued across the Gaza Strip despite a US-brokered ceasefire that has been in place since October 2025. Namita S Kalla September 01, 2026 / 09:16 IST There are words that can help you convey how you feel more effectively. (Picture: AI generated) Unusual words describe feelings beyond everyday vocabulary. Querencia: feeling safe and at home with a person/place. Dor: deep, painful longing for someone/something absent. Did our AI summary help? Market Mastery Webinar by Vishal Malkan Find the weak links in your portfolio by Vishal Malkan Register for FREE Webinar Register for FREE There are feelings that refuse to fit neatly into words. A person can make a room feel safer. Someone's absence can leave an ache with no obvious name. You can care for somebody quietly, fiercely, even instinctively, without ever finding the right expression. English often leaves these shades of emotion frustratingly unnamed. But look beyond everyday vocabulary and some wonderfully unusual words emerge — words that give shape to feelings we normally struggle to describe. Here are five worth remembering: Querencia Pronunciation: keh-REN-see-uh Meaning: A person, place or state where one feels safe, comfortable and completely at home. Originally a Spanish word, querencia describes the place where someone feels most secure. Used emotionally, it can describe the person whose presence makes the world feel gentler. Usage: After years of wandering, she found her querencia in his quiet company. Also read: This 1 lifestyle factor is more dangerous than alcohol and obesity, warns health expert Eunoia Pronunciation: yoo-NOY-uh Meaning: Beautiful thinking or a gracious, well-disposed mind towards another. From ancient Greek, eunoia describes a benevolent way of thinking about someone. It is not loud or theatrical. It is simply wishing another person well, without demanding anything in return. Usage: There was genuine eunoia in the way she remembered her childhood friend. Stor ge Pronunciation: STOR-jee Meaning: A natural, instinctive affection, particularly between family members. Storge is the quiet bond built through familiarity and shared life. It is not the exaggerated feeling of a love story; it is the instinct to care because someone has become part of your world. Usage: His storge for his ageing parents appeared in countless small acts of care. Dor Pronunciation: dohr Meaning: A deep, sometimes painful longing for someone or something absent. This Romanian word is notoriously difficult to translate precisely. Dor can contain homesickness, yearning and emotional ache at the same time, the feeling of missing something that still has a hold on you. Usage: Even after decades abroad, she carried a dor for her childhood home. Also read: Suhana Khan serves high-glam fashion looks in Alex Perry and Versace attire, see pics Limerence Pronunciation: LIM-uh-rents Meaning: An intense, involuntary infatuation marked by persistent thoughts and a strong desire for reciprocation. Limerence is the restless side of attachment. It is thinking about someone repeatedly, replaying conversations, searching for signs and wondering whether they feel the same. Usage: What he believed was love slowly revealed itself to be limerence. Rare words matter because they do not just make language sound clever; they help us separate feelings that everyday vocabulary bundles together. Sometimes it is safety. Sometimes it is yearning. Sometimes it is instinct. And sometimes, inconveniently, it is all of them at once. https://www.clactonandfrintongazette.co..text: Stansted Airport Leisure Travel Essex Jet2 announce Christmas market flights from Stansted Airport Stansted Airport Leisure Travel Essex By Mason Lewsey Reporter Share 0 Comments Jet2 - The airline has announced new Christmas market flights departing from Stansted Airport (Image: Getty Images) This article is brought to you by our exclusive subscriber partnership with our sister title USA Today, and has been written by our American colleagues. It does not necessarily reflect the view of The Herald. Jet2 has announced a new range of Christmas market flights departing from Stansted Airport. The airline will offer more than 23,000 seats to popular Christmas market destinations for the 2027/28 winter season, including Krakow, Prague, Vienna, and Strasbourg. Stansted will be Jet2’s only airport offering flights to Strasbourg. Steve Heapy, chief executive of Jet2, said: "Christmas Market breaks are a firm favourite with our customers, that is why we have put over 23,000 seats on sale from London Stansted Airport , including four fantastic Christmas Markets routes, giving customers in the Southeast great choice and flexibility when booking. "By putting the programme on sale now, customers can get their plans in the diary early and look forward to a fantastic getaway next winter." Flights will run two to four times a week over the festive period, allowing short breaks, long weekends and longer trips. Jet2 will fly from Stansted to Krakow and Prague up to four times a week, on Mondays, Thursdays, Fridays and Sundays. Read more Essex airport to host careers fair with over 500 jobs on offer Stansted Airport issues travel warning as major route closes for five days Ryanair 'cutting' more than half a million seats to two European countries Vienna flights will also run up to four times a week on those days. Flights to Strasbourg will run twice a week, on Mondays and Fridays. Jet2 currently has flights on sale for Winter 2026/27, Summer 2027 and Winter 2027/28. The dedicated Christmas market flights are part of the airline’s wider winter programme, giving travellers the chance to experience some of Europe’s most popular festive destinations. Customers and independent travel agents can now book flights for the 2027/28 winter season through Jet2. Beállítom Összeütközött két katonai repülőgép egy kiképzőrepülés közben a Fülöp-szigeteken, a balesetben mind a négy pilóta meghalt, írja az AP. A két SF–260-as típusú repülőgép péntek délután, alacsony magasságban ütközött össze, majd lezuhant a Manilától délre fekvő Batangas tartományban, a lipai Fernando légibázison. A földön senki sem sérült meg. A Fülöp-szigeteki légierő egyelőre nem közölt részleteket a baleset körülményeiről, de két, az ügyet ismerő tisztviselő az AP-nek megerősítette, hogy a gépek a levegőben ütköztek össze. Egy szemtanú szerint az egyik kétüléses repülőgép a légibázison szolgáló katonák szállásának közelében zuhant le. A légierő vizsgálatot indított, és annak lezárásáig ideiglenesen leállította az Olaszországból beszerzett SF–260-as repülőgépek használatát. Nem ez volt az első halálos baleset a Fülöp-szigeteki légierő SF–260-as gépeivel. Májusban egy navigációs kiképzőrepülés során zuhant le egy ilyen repülőgép Benguet tartományban, akkor két pilóta vesztette életét. 2023-ban egy másik SF–260-as csapódott egy rizsföldbe Bataan tartományban, szintén két ember halálát okozva. Az újabb baleset tovább nehezíti a forráshiánnyal küzdő Fülöp-szigeteki hadsereg helyzetét, amely évek óta próbálja korszerűsíteni légierejét, haditengerészetét és szárazföldi erőit.
